title: Extend the current environment and compose runs
description: Investigate and adapt runs, interfaces and capabilities using their current owners and evidence.
applicability: Use when a task needs a new tool, MCP connection, interface, worker environment, run, or a change to its current capabilities.

content.text: Find the owner of the behavior you need to change and follow its relevant inputs, outputs and consumers. Read the current contracts and source where they answer an uncertainty. Use existing composition or descriptor capabilities when they fit; extend an owner package when they do not. Verify the effect at the boundary that matters and investigate related state when a result contradicts the plan. Publish the reusable lesson with its demonstrated conditions and any untested part, rather than a transcript or a claim based only on preparation.
